Production: any compatibility-breaking change must provide a one-time migration, documented in the migration guide, run automatically at startup, isolated from main code and easy to remove when legacy support ends.

Priorities (every decision): Never lose data; Keep and Enhance POSIX/rsync Operational Correctness; Never stall reads; Keep performance as high as possible.

Build: `cargo build --release`

Prefer integration over unit tests. For filesystem tests, always use OS commands; never interact with the system’s internal API. Run full tests for big changes; focused tests for small changes. Don't test what the type system guarantees.

VerFSNext: Rust COW FUSE filesystem; UltraCDC chunks (XXH3-128), deduplicated and compressed in-line into zstd-seekable packs; KV-only metadata; idle GC reclaims space. Snapshots: root `.snapshots`; encrypted root `.vault`.

`vendor/` is hard-forked; treat as our own code and make needed fixes.

Docs: `docs/technical_deep_dive.md`; `vendor/surrealkv/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.

DO NOT CREATE NEW TESTS IF YOU ARE NOT EXPLICITLY ASKED TO DO SO.
DO NOT PRESERVE BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY IF NOT EXPLICITLY ASKED TO DO SO.
DO NOT COMMENT OUT OR KEEP LEGACY CODE IN THE CODEBASE, IF YOU NEED TO CHANGE SOMETHING, CHANGE IT AND REMOVE THE OLD CODE.
DO NOT USE PIP, ALWAYS USE UV AND GIVE INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO USE IT.
DO NOT ADD FALLBACKS
DO NOT WRITE DEFENSIVE CODE
